messages:
Maria A.: heads up — noticed a new pattern where token attribution jumps ~4-7% for routes hitting shard-affinity after the rollout. not sure if it's a metering tag loss or route join reordering.
Ajay: can you paste an example event where it diverged?
Maria A.: gave one to debug stack: `route_id=shard-17, tenant=acme, session_id=abc123, tokens=482` then invoice preview shows tokens=460.
Kevin: ouch. is this specific to >=v2.9 of the route-resolver? we changed affinity sticky keys there.
Maria A.: seems correlated with the v2.9 canary. only seen in EU region so far.
Chris: pinging @Billing Bot to see if dedupe or postproc TTL might drop late route enrichments.
Billing Bot: deploy 2024-08-21T03:12:07Z processed route-enrich v3.4. metric: enrichment_latency_p99=1.4s, enrichment_missed=0.6%
Ajay: thanks. Maria, can you capture the raw ingest event and the enriched event? paste with obfuscated ids.
Maria A.: pasted snippet: ```
{"event_ts":"2024-08-21T02:59:01Z","proxy_route":"shard-17","client_id":"t-***","tokens":482,"route_hint":null}
...enriched->```
```
{"event_ts":"2024-08-21T02:59:01Z","route_id":"shard-17","tenant":"acme","tokens":482,"enrich_ts":"2024-08-21T02:59:02Z","tenant_plan":"pro"}
```
Kevin: enrichment looks fine. where does invoice preview read tokens=460? which consumer?
Maria A.: invoice-preview consumer is ledger-preview-v2, windowed aggregate by hourly watermark.
Chris: maybe windowing or late-arrival trimming is dropping partial sessions. Replicate locally: run a replay of that event into preview pipeline.
Ajay: quick check — we recently tightened the preview dedupe window from 5m -> 2m in #5203. if enrichment arrived after 2m it could be excluded.
Elaine: that change was to reduce double-counting on retries. we believed anchors handled reorder, but maybe affinity routing increases enrichment latency.
Kevin: can someone grep enrichment_latency for shard-17 around that time?
Maria A.: grep log: `enrich_latency_ms=1650` for that event, p50 ~120ms, p99 ~1400ms.
Ops Oncall: I saw transient spike on eu-infra around 02:58 due to autoscaler churn. pods were rescheduled for 60s.
Chris: autoscaler churn + stricter dedupe window = plausible root cause. but still need to confirm why tokens are lower (482->460). that suggests either a partial session credit lost or our token normalization changed.
Ajay: token normalization: we apply whitespace collapse, then tokenizer on ingress. Could we be double-normalizing in enrichment join and preview aggregator?
Maria A.: diffs from code: ingress normalized, enrichment was supposed to keep raw_tokens, but a recent refactor accidentally used normalized field for invoice unitization.
Kevin: that could reduce token count when unicode normalization strips combined glyphs. not huge but 4-7% matches.
Elaine: plan: 1) backfill replay for the hour into ledger-preview-v2 with enrichment enforced earlier 2) revert dedupe window to 5m for preview (hotfix) 3) patch enrichment to include raw_tokens field explicitly and add unit tests.
Chris: agree. who owns the hotfix? I can take preview config rollback.
Ops Oncall: taking rollback now — will route preview to previous config. ETA 7m.
Billing Bot: rollback applied by ops at 2024-08-21T03:05:11Z, preview_dedupe_window=300s
Maria A.: I'll prepare the replay job and flag affected tenants (acme + flagged list).
Ajay: also suggest adding a new console card: per-route enrichment_latency vs invoice_delta (preview_vs_final) so we can catch these regressions during rollouts. small dashboard tile.
Kevin: +1. add health alert if enrichment_missed >0.2% for 5m.
Elaine: will file infra ticket for unit tests and add canary guard in pipeline to block route-resolver rollouts if enrichment_p99 > 800ms.
Chris: noted. Maria, after replay can you post delta of tokens for that hour? we need evidence before blaming normalization.
Maria A.: replay job queued, running now (replay-id=rp-20240821-17). will post summary when done.
Ops Oncall: replay finished. short summary: preview showed -5.1% tokens for affected tenants during the hour; after replay with corrected enrichment stream, preview vs final aligned within 0.3%.
Ajay: excellent — that strongly implicates late enrichment + dedupe window + a normalization refactor.
Kevin: follow-ups: PR for raw_tokens patch, add unit tests, dashboard card, alert, and enforce canary gating.
Elaine: filing follow-ups: infra-1234 (unit tests & patch), ui-5678 (dashboard tile), ops-9012 (canary gate).
Maria A.: thanks all. I'll update the incident board and notify affected CSMs. :thumbsup:
Chris: nice triage. :tada:
Billing Bot: incident-note: preview_rollback_and_replay_resolved at 2024-08-21T03:45:00Z
